subject: You found a floppy!
body:
You found a floppy disk! Put it in a computer, or hold it in one hand and use your phone with the other. Once it's in, whatever was on it stays with your account. Some of them open up new parts of Antazon. One I found had a whole game on it.

The Disks app keeps track of every disk you've found, and leaves a blank spot for the ones you haven't.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
